Omschrijving

Fully Furnished Studio Apartment for Rent – Amsterdam Zeeburg - temporary rental
John Blankensteinstraat, Amsterdam

Preference for students

A bright and well-maintained studio apartment, fully furnished and located in the popular residential area of Amsterdam Zeeburg. Situated on the second floor of a modern apartment complex built in 2018, this studio offers comfortable and practical living in a convenient location.

The property is available for a temporary rental period of up to 24 months.

The Studio

Bright and comfortable living/sleeping area
Modern open-plan kitchen
Bathroom with shower, toilet and washbasin
Fully furnished and ready to move in
Efficient and practical layout
Kitchen Facilities
The modern open kitchen is fully equipped with:
Dishwasher
Induction hob with extractor hood
Oven
Fridge/freezer combination

Location

The studio is situated in Amsterdam Zeeburg, a pleasant and well-connected neighbourhood with shops, restaurants, supermarkets and public transport within easy reach. The area offers a comfortable residential atmosphere while providing convenient access to Amsterdam city centre.

Rental Conditions
Monthly rent: €1,650
Service costs: €150 per month
Total monthly rent: €1,800 (excluding utilities)

Security deposit: Two months' rent
Furnished: Yes
